verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU/NPU silicon). Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a setting of the operating system or software services, not of the chip, so this axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships its own telemetry or opt-out controls that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
